channel.title: Gamescool blog
channel.description: News, updates and guides for the free browser games on Gamescool.

item.title: Solder Bench brings keyboard building to Gamescool
item.description: Build an eleven-key mechanical keyboard in Solder Bench. Learn what you assemble, how soldering works, and the controls for mouse and phone.

item.title: Night Brawler beginner's guide to controls and combat
item.description: Learn Night Brawler's keyboard, controller and phone controls, then practise combos, perfect dodges and Biscuit's tackle.

item.title: Kite Wanderer beginner's guide to controls and exploration
item.description: Learn Kite Wanderer's keyboard, controller and phone controls, navigate the opening cave, and manage stamina, combat and saves.

item.title: Ridge Hunters brings an idle party RPG to Gamescool
item.description: Meet Ridge Hunters, an idle party RPG with a short prologue. Learn where your heroes go and how to steer them on keyboard or touch.

item.title: Chopper Rush beginner's guide to takeoff and landing
item.description: Learn Chopper Rush's keyboard, controller and phone controls, start the turbine, practise hovering and make your first paid landing.

item.title: Dead Hollow beginner's guide to surviving Cedar Hollow
item.description: Learn Dead Hollow's keyboard, controller and phone controls, choose your starting mode, and follow the opening route to a safehouse.

item.title: This week on Gamescool: five new games
item.description: Catch up on five new games, three updates and the week's most played games, with play counts and hours from Player stats.

item.title: Wayang Rush beginner’s guide to controls and your first duel
item.description: Learn Wayang Rush’s keyboard, controller and phone controls, choose a mode, and prepare for your first duel in the temple.

item.title: Wayang beginner's guide to controls, ink and the Guardian
item.description: Learn Wayang's keyboard and controller controls, how to keep damage from healing, and when to turn life into ink.

item.title: Night Brawler brings four street corners to Gamescool
item.description: Meet Dex and Biscuit in Night Brawler, a free browser brawler. Get the controls and learn how dodges, tackles and air combos work.

item.title: Wayang Rush tips for parries, counters and stamina
item.description: Learn Wayang Rush's parry timing, counter rhythm, stamina management and heavy slash openings, plus how to handle each phase.

item.title: Site Wrecker is out on Gamescool
item.description: Turn a website into a demolition level in Site Wrecker. Get the controls, device requirements and what to expect from your first run.
